seo.title: Carrd vs Wix — Choose the Best Website Builder for Landing Pages
seo.meta_description: Compare Carrd and Wix: speed, price, ease of use, features, and e-commerce. Find out whether a simple landing page (Carrd) or a scalable website (Wix) is right

hero.headline: Carrd vs Wix
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.winner_hint: Best for fast, low-cost landing pages
summary.best_for_a: Carrd is ideal for creators and small businesses who need a single fast, affordable landing page, link-in-bio, or portfolio without a learning curve.
summary.best_for_b: Wix is best for users who want a full-featured website builder with drag-and-drop design, e-commerce, and an app marketplace to scale a brand or online store.
summary.quick_take: Choose Carrd when you want the quickest route to a clean, focused one-page site at a tiny price. Choose Wix when you need breadth: advanced design controls, apps, and commerce tools that let your site grow into a full business presence. Carrd wins on simplicity and cost; Wix wins on features and scale.

rows.tool_a: Extremely simple — minimal controls focused on one-page layouts.
rows.tool_b: User-friendly but feature-rich — drag-and-drop freedom requires a short learning curve.

rows.tool_a: Very low-cost plans and a usable free tier; paid upgrades are inexpensive.
rows.tool_b: Free plan available, but premium features, apps, and e-commerce raise monthly cost.

rows.tool_a: Clean, modern one-page templates optimized for conversion and speed.
rows.tool_b: Huge template library and pixel-level design control across multiple pages.

rows.tool_a: Focused feature set for forms, embeds, and basic media — limited extensibility.
rows.tool_b: Robust feature set including blogging, bookings, memberships, and advanced site logic.

rows.tool_a: Very limited — best for linking to external payment pages or simple donations.
rows.tool_b: Comprehensive e-commerce tools with product catalogs, checkout, and payment options.

rows.tool_a: Basic SEO controls and fast load times that help performance.
rows.tool_b: Built-in SEO tools, marketing integrations, and advanced settings for growth.

rows.tool_a: Lightweight pages load very fast; hosting included and optimized for small sites.
rows.tool_b: Hosting included but larger sites and apps can slow load times without optimization.

rows.tool_a: Limited integrations; supports embeds and simple third-party tools.
rows.tool_b: Large app marketplace and extensive third-party integrations for marketing and commerce.

rows.tool_a: Documentation and community help; no premium support layers required for simple sites.
rows.tool_b: Extensive help center, tutorials, and paid support options for businesses.

rows.tool_a: Landing pages, event pages, link-in-bio, and micro sites.
rows.tool_b: Business websites, stores, blogs, and multi-page brand sites.

paragraphs: Picking the right website tool comes down to scope: a single fast landing page or a full website with store and apps. Carrd and Wix both help you get online quickly, but they solve different problems.
This comparison cuts through features, cost, ease of use, and real-world use cases so you can decide which platform turns visitors into customers faster for your project.

data.headline: Simplicity vs. Scale
data.summary: If your goal is a fast, inexpensive landing page or portfolio, Carrd gives the most value with zero fuss. If you need a multi-page site, e-commerce, or a customizable platform to expand, Wix is the more capable choice despite higher cost and complexity.

items.question: Can I sell products on Carrd or Wix?
items.answer: Carrd supports basic payment embeds and redirects to payment providers but isn’t a full e-commerce platform; Wix provides built-in e-commerce features for product listings, checkout, and payments.

items.question: Which platform is faster to launch?
items.answer: Carrd is faster to launch — you can have a one-page site live in minutes. Wix takes longer if you customize templates or set up commerce and apps.

items.question: Do both platforms support custom domains and SSL?
items.answer: Yes — both Carrd and Wix support custom domains and include SSL, though connecting a domain may require a paid plan on each platform.

items.question: Which is better for SEO?
items.answer: Wix offers more advanced SEO tools and settings for multi-page sites; Carrd benefits from fast load times and simple markup for basic SEO needs.

items.question: Can I move my site from Carrd to Wix or vice versa?
items.answer: There’s no automated exporter between platforms; you can migrate content manually, but design and structure will need rebuilding when switching builders.

items.question: Which platform has a lower ongoing cost?
items.answer: Carrd generally has a lower ongoing cost for simple one-page sites. Wix can become more expensive once you add premium plans, apps, and e-commerce features.
